source.title: Thunderfists of Ra-den's Chosen — indexed Wowhead Looter Disenchanting table
source.author: Wowhead Looter community aggregate

notes: Original item-base Wowhead Looter aggregate, display row 1/2: 19 source-reported disenchants, 11 reported material occurrences for an unlabeled-rank Dawn Crystal. Linked material itemID/rank, per-hit quantity and positive-stack histogram not surfaced in indexed text. PTR 12.1.5 listing; user-selected Mythic/ilvl is preview only. The page's selected item quality/ilvl and PTR URL are not evidence of the original operation build or bonus. The two same-name rows may be distinct ranked outputs and MUST NOT be merged, mapped to candidate IDs, summed as distinct casts or used to infer zero-output disenchants. No individual cast log, player skill/spec or original dates available. Research-only pending linked material and actual variant evidence; source is cumulative by base item, do not import later live/PTR snapshots as new cohorts.
